title: The poem's images
back: Tigers, screen, ivory needle, wedding band, terrified hands.

title: Three stanzas, three moves
back: Tigers prance, fearless → fluttering fingers, the ring → terrified hands in death, tigers go on.

title: Bright topaz denizens
svg: <svg viewBox="-12 0 344 200" role="img" aria-label="Prancing across the screen, unafraid of the men beneath the tree" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="40" y="30" width="240" height="130" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="6" rx="4"/><rect x="48" y="38" width="224" height="114" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.06" stroke="none"/><g><path d="M70,116.48 Q60,59.36 94.0,56.0 L182.0,52.639999999999986 Q217.20000000000002,22.39999999999999 233.2,49.27999999999999 L242.8,69.44 Q239.60000000000002,86.24 214.0,86.24 L207.6,106.4 L207.6,140 H188.4 V113.12 L169.2,113.12 V140 H150.0 V111.776 L118.0,111.776 V140 H98.8 V113.12 Q79.6,109.75999999999999 70,116.48 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><path d="M74,72.8 Q42,66.07999999999998 52,25.760000000000005 Q56,49.27999999999999 76,64.73599999999999 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><path d="M188.4,52.639999999999986 L182.0,29.120000000000005 L204.4,42.56 Z M223.6,35.83999999999999 L230.0,15.679999999999993 L242.8,42.56 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><path d="M111.6,59.36 q6,23.52 0,47.04 M130.8,59.36 q6,23.52 0,47.04 M150.0,59.36 q6,23.52 0,47.04 M169.2,59.36 q6,23.52 0,47.04 " fill="none" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="222.0" cy="52.639999999999986" r="2.5" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/></g><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Prancing across the screen, unafraid of the men beneath the tree</text></svg>
back: Embroidered, not real. Golden, free, chivalric — a knight's confidence. Everything their maker lacks.

title: The weight of the wedding band
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Uncle's ring, massive on her hand" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g transform="translate(150,100) scale(1.4)"><path d="M-30,40 Q-34,10 -20,-20 L-12,-20 L-14,10 L-8,-34 L0,-34 L-2,8 L4,-40 L12,-40 L8,10 L16,-26 L24,-26 L18,22 Q14,44 0,48 Q-26,50 -30,40 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/></g><circle cx="178" cy="118" r="22" fill="none" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="9"/><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Uncle's ring, massive on her hand</text></svg>
back: Physically light; symbolically the burden of an oppressive marriage that makes even the ivory needle hard to pull.

title: Fingers fluttering through wool
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Nervous, weak — a trapped bird's wings" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g transform="translate(60,160) scale(1.2)"><path d="M0,0 L90,-90" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M80,-80 L96,-96 L92,-100 L76,-84 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><circle cx="10" cy="-10" r="5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/></g><circle cx="80" cy="150" r="14" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.5" stroke="none"/><circle cx="100" cy="165" r="10" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.5" stroke="none"/><text x="230" y="90" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">hard to pull</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Nervous, weak — a trapped bird's wings</text></svg>
back: The verb 'flutter' gives the aunt's hands the movement of a frightened bird; the lightest tool is an effort.

title: Ringed with ordeals
back: Her hands will lie still, ringed. Her art outlives her: proud and unafraid.

title: Art as the free self
back: A feminist protest without slogans: a woman crushed by marriage pours her courage into tigers. The poem honours the art and indicts the cage.

title: The phrase to recognise
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Line to remember" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g><rect x="28" y="36" width="264" height="72" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" rx="10"/><path d="M50,108 L42,122 L64,108 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><text x="160.0" y="78.3" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">chivalric certainty</text></g><text x="160" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.8" stroke="none">— how the tigers pace</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Line to remember</text></svg>
back: Like medieval knights: noble, brave, graceful, honourable. The dignity and courage the aunt admires but was never allowed.
